name: Uptime Kuma
param_style: ? positional through redbean-node/knex (R.getAll raw SQL; R.find/findOne/count wrap a WHERE fragment); normalised to ?N
schema_source: CREATE statements dumped from db/kuma.db after db/old_migrations patch1-10 + patchList (as server/database.js applies them), plus the db/knex_migrations that touch these tables translated to SQLite DDL
data_scale: scale 1: 100 monitors, 150k heartbeats (~700 important), 130k stat_minutely, 65k stat_hourly, 33k stat_daily, 233 monitor tags, 5 status pages / 15 groups, 120 incidents
visibility_note: 93k stars, one of the most-deployed self-hosted apps; SQLite is the default database
interest_note: Mostly short, very hot statements: per-check heartbeat insert and previous-beat lookup, per-beat aggregate UPSERTs, partial-index scans for important events, and dashboard aggregates (grouped MAX(id) join-back, CASE-conditional SUMs over stat tables).
